description: A chess game box sits on the table in front of a red cloth backdrop. Both hands move in to grasp the box lid as a two-hand object and lift it upward, then the right hand shifts the lid to the right side and releases it; next the right hand picks up two small plastic bags of pieces one at a time as right-hand objects and sets them into the moved lid, while both hands return to the base to grip the folded board as a two-hand object and lift it out toward the camera, starting to unfold it onto the table.
